description: Make a new sequence from the part of a sequence between its in and out points (Sequence > Make Subsequence), on the targeted tracks or on every track. Set the in and out points first (set_sequence_times or mark_clips)

allTracks.description: Take every track, ignoring track targeting. Default false

open.description: Open the new sequence in the Timeline. Default false

sequence.description: Which sequence. Give its name or guid (from list_sequences); omit for the active sequence

name: create_subsequence
title: Create Subsequence
